title: Donostia urban mobility
subtitle: Multimodal journey app
deck: Bus, bike and walking in a single journey across the city.
role: User research, information architecture and interface design.

sections.title: Context and brief
paragraphs: Getting around Donostia often means mixing bus, bike and walking, each with its own app.

sections.title: Approach
paragraphs: User research, information architecture and an interactive prototype that plans and guides a combined journey.
